Site Credits

This application has been developed independently on a voluntary basis by the team at The Restorationist, as a gift to children in Britain without a voice. We have no connection to the Lowe Inquiry or government inquiry; we were not solicited to build this for either of them; nor are we are endorsed by them. We maintain everything at our own cost, which we pay gladly.

Technology Leadership

Alexander Coppen is a senior English engineering director based in California, with over two decades of managing sophisticated technology projects with sensitive operations. He is responsible for the software and infrastructure of TellSomeone.

ac@restorationist.org.uk
@HWoodTrashIII

Legal Leadership

Michael Reiners is an English lawyer based in the UK accountable to the Bar Standards Board, with many years of deep experience overseeing sensitive cases. He is responsible for the legal oversight of processing and disclosure at TellSomeone.

mcr@restorationist.org.uk
@MCRReiners

The website and all services are available 24/7 at no charge for any good faith British political organisation, charity, or concerned group to collect evidence of ongoing sexual crime from the documented, epidemic, and devastating rape gang activity in our country. We wrote to multiple organisations about their own attempts at offering "whistleblowing," services, outlining serious safeguarding concerns. We offered them sophisticated, military-grade technology for free, and every one of them simply ignored it.

We will never charge for it, never solicit donations, nor use the horror of this ongoing tragedy to promote any sectarian, partisan, or private cause. If you care about children, you can use this service to help them tell someone what happened to them.

Our Thanks

TellSomeone is the result of ongoing collaboration by a team of motivated contributors who care deeply about what's happened to children in Britain: Chris, Andy, Leo, Harry, Tim, Alfred, and more.

If you'd like to help and have no problem with DBS vetting, please get in touch.
